content: The API Dem_EnableDTCSetting shall trigger the callback function InitMonitorForEvent of the related event(s) in case ControlDTCSetting of the event(s) is re-enabled. The InitMonitorReason parameter shall be set to DEM_INIT_MONITOR_REENABLED .
